claim: TubeArchivist requires three containers (app, Redis, Elasticsearch 8) and ~2GB RAM for testing, ~4GB for mid/large installs, dual-core/4-thread CPU minimum.
quote: around 2GB of available memory for a small testing setup and around 4GB of available memory for a mid to large sized installation

claim: TubeArchivist (8.1k stars) ships its own web interface for organizing, searching and playing archived videos offline.
quote: organize, search and enjoy your archived YouTube videos without hassle offline through a convenient web interface

claim: A dedicated Jellyfin metadata-provider plugin syncs TubeArchivist's rich metadata into Jellyfin via a scheduled task, with bidirectional playlist sync from v1.4.1.
quote: Metadata for your TubeArchivist library on Jellyfin

claim: TubeSync (2.7k stars) is a containerized PVR wrapping yt-dlp+ffmpeg, sorting audio-only into an audio/ dir and video into video/, with native Plex and Jellyfin library updates post-download.
quote: Currently TubeSync supports Plex and Jellyfin as media servers

claim: Pinchflat (5.0k stars) is a single self-contained Docker container with no external dependencies, uses SQLite (WAL), and offers first-class Plex/Jellyfin/Kodi support plus a powerful naming system, audio-only downloads, SponsorBlock and RSS feeds.
quote: self-contained - just one Docker container with no external dependencies

claim: Operators report Plex collapses distinct Pinchflat sources into generic Shows despite separate tvshow.nfo files, an integration quirk on the Plex side.
quote: Plex imports separate Pinchflat sources as generic “Shows” / collapses them together despite distinct tvshow.nfo files

claim: ytdl-sub (2.8k stars) is a Python/yt-dlp tool deployable via Docker (incl. an LSIO code-server Web-GUI image), pip, or native; YAML presets generate NFO sidecars and named folders for Kodi/Jellyfin/Plex/Emby TV shows, music and music videos.
quote: LSIO's code-server Docker image with ytdl-sub preinstalled

claim: ytdl-sub ships prebuilt TV-show presets that output episode .nfo files with date-like episode names populated from video metadata that Kodi recognizes.
quote: each video can have an episode NFO file with a date-like episode name

claim: MeTube (13.8k stars) is a single stateless Docker container web UI for yt-dlp storing only queue/completed JSON files; it offers global/preset/per-download format and OUTPUT_TEMPLATE naming control but has no NFO generation or media-server integration.
quote: Download videos, audio, captions, and thumbnails from a browser UI

claim: MeTube is distributed as the ghcr.io/alexta69/metube Docker image, run with a single port and a /downloads volume.
quote: Self-hosted video downloader for YouTube and other sites (web UI for youtube-dl / yt-dlp)

claim: Operator report: Pinchflat's NFO/metadata/thumbnail output drops cleanly into a Jellyfin YouTube library with minimal setup.
quote: This free self-hosted app turned my Jellyfin server into a YouTube archive overnight
